## LeadFlow Sync (demo)
Form lead → validate → CRM lookup & de-dupe → classify (Claude or rules) → HubSpot create/update → Slack → run log.

Every HTTP step retries (3 tries, 1 s apart). Failures that survive the retries are logged and alerted in #leadflow-alerts.

URLs and flags come from environment variables, tokens from n8n credentials: nothing secret is stored in this workflow.

### Failure path
CRM or Slack errors that survive the retries end up here: the lead is logged with the failing step and an alert is posted.
